title: CritCrafter sheet
description: The JSON the critcrafterSheet function returns and the CritCrafter viewer renders. Source: wayfinder ticket #486 (see docs/critcrafter/SPEC.md). Evolution is additive-only within a schemaVersion: producers may add optional fields, consumers must ignore unknown fields, and a consumer that sees a schemaVersion it does not know shows a hard 'reload to update' state. Invariants a schema cannot express (the function guarantees them, fixture tests check them): (1) for every Stat, sum(breakdown[].amount) === value; (2) arrays are in display order (cost: free, 1, 2, 3, reaction; a range sorts by its minimum); (3) keys are deterministic from the export: '<section>:<normalised-name>#<nth occurrence>' (nth counts from 1 within the same section and normalised name), spell slot keys are 'slots:<casterKey>:<rank>', and the corpus SHA never enters a key; (4) all rules text is inline sanitised HTML, safe to render, with data-ref markers rendered as plain text; (5) placeholders ('Not set', 'None selected') are normalised away before they reach the sheet. Size budget: 500 KB raw / 150 KB gzip for a typical build, hard cap 2 MB (the function fails loudly instead of truncating).

schemaVersion.description: Bumped only for a breaking change. The viewer checks only this field at runtime.

sha.description: The foundryvtt/pf2e commit the rules corpus mirrors (rulesMeta/current.sha). Never part of any key.

warnings.description: Everything the function swallowed: unmatched names, breakdown residuals, dropped pseudo-casters, unknown mods labels or types, unparseable familiar names. No viewer UI in v1. Logged by code and count only; detail is never logged.

skills.description: The 16 core skills first, then lores.

code.description: Stable machine code, e.g. name_unmatched, breakdown_residual, caster_dropped, mods_unknown_label, mods_unknown_type, max_hp_mismatch, focus_multiple_traditions, other_spells_no_dc, familiar_unparsed.

path.description: Sheet path the warning is about, e.g. 'skills[3].bonus'.

detail.description: Human-readable. May contain names from the export, so it is never logged.

stat.description: A derived number. Every derived number in the sheet is a Stat so the viewer can open a breakdown. Invariant: sum(breakdown[].amount) === value. Where Pathbuilder precomputes a total (weapon attack, damage bonus, acTotal, total HP) and the rebuilt parts disagree, Pathbuilder's value wins and a line labelled 'Other (from Pathbuilder)' carries the residual (plus a warning). Untrained rows show 'Untrained' with amount 0 and no level line.

actions.description: Corpus actions linked to this stat (e.g. Athletics: Grapple, Trip, Shove), with full rules text. Stat-to-action link is one-way.

cost.description: Never a parsed string. null for passives. 'actions' uses min (and max for a range such as 1 to 3).

rules.description: null is a corpus miss: the viewer shows name plus aonUrl, with no placeholder text.

html.description: Sanitised HTML. The function guarantees safety.

license.description: Per-entry licence tag from system.publication.license of the entry whose text is shown (an alias shows the remaster entry's text and its tag).

entry.description: The common shape of every resolved name: feats, specials, actions, spells, items.

traits.description: Plain labels in v1; not interactive.

count.description: Duplicates with the same name and option merged into one row shown as ×n. Absent when 1.

option.description: A feat's selected option (tuple element 1). A label only, shown as 'Skill Training (Intimidation)'.

aonUrl.description: AoN search URL on a miss; null for custom content.

linked.description: Scrolls and wands (and later families): the spell the item casts, kept separate from the item's own text.

size.description: From sizeName, not the ordinal size.

hp.description: Max HP. Current HP, temp HP and shield HP live in the viewer store.

mod.description: No breakdown: ability mods are not tappable.

bulk.description: A number, the string 'L' for light, or null when unknown (counts as 0 in the Gear Bulk stat and appears there as a labelled breakdown line).

hands.description: Hands used in the base grip.

versatile.description: The alternate grip's hands, or null.

dice.description: Dice string with damage type, e.g. '1d8 S'.

bonus.description: One untyped 'Pathbuilder damage bonus' line; no Strength decomposition.

worn.description: Initial held state from the export, when it carries one.

acTotal.description: AC as if this armor alone were worn, shield lowered.

wornInExport.description: Initial worn state. Client AC = (worn armor acTotal, else header.unarmoredAc) + (shield raised ? shield acBonus : 0). One body armor at a time; layered armor is out of v1.

acBonus.description: Coerced from Pathbuilder's string shieldBonus; its own breakdown line.

hands.description: Hands used while equipped (a buckler: only while raised, see buckler).

hp.description: Max shield HP; current shield HP lives in the viewer store.

gear.description: Containers are ignored: every list is flat, with qty applied.

bulk.description: Sum of listed items (qty applied, 1000 coins = 1 Bulk). Shown as 'Bulk n / limit' atop Gear. Ignores equip state.

attack.description: null for 'Other Spells (Staves etc)' (unreliable proficiency), with a warning.

slots.description: Max slots per rank; keys are rank numbers as strings. Slot usage keys are 'slots:<casterKey>:<rank>'.

ranks.description: spells and prepared unioned, duplicates merged with count. Highest rank last.

spells.description: The viewer hides the Spells tab when casters is empty, focus is null and rituals is empty.

attack.description: From the highest-bonus entry when several traditions exist; a warning lists the others.

groupedEntries.description: Used by 'actions' (groups in order: class, ancestry, general, archetype, familiar, basic, exploration, skill) and 'features' (the same source groups, entries ordered by feat level, no cost). Empty groups are omitted.

defaultOpen.description: Actions: the first five groups open, basic/exploration/skill collapsed.
